verdict.rationale: Built-in accessibility warnings are a fair question for a UI framework, but the evidence pack never mentions React emitting accessibility warnings during development. React Developer Tools are documented only for inspecting components, editing props/state and finding performance problems, and eslint-plugin-react-hooks covers hooks rules, not accessibility. Neither is credited here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get built-in accessibility warnings during development instead of relying on separate audit tools
